general.notes: Active Direct Attach Cable (DAC) coax (not optical fiber). Cable lengths 1 m, 2 m, 3 m (3.3–9.8 ft); AWG30 for SO-CFP2-QSFP28-xM. SO-CFP2-QSFP28-xM: CDR in receive direction only; SO-CFP2-QSFP28-xM-2: CDR in transmit and receive. Requires FEC in host systems. Power stated as 1.3 W per connector.
general.suggestions: Consider schema fields for cable_length_m, cable_awg, interface_type (coax DAC), and cdr_configuration (RX-only vs dual) for DAC/adaptor products without optical parameters.
